description: Defines the Image class within the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel.Shapes namespace, representing an image element in a document with properties like Name, ScaleWidth, ScaleHeight, LockAspectRatio, PictureFormat, Resolution, and Interpolate. Includes methods for cloning, serialization, and file path retrieval.

classes.name: Image
classes.description: Represents an image in a document, with properties for image attributes and methods for serialization, cloning, and file path management.

classes.name: ImageValues
classes.description: Internal class holding nullable property values for the Image class.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Image object.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Implements deep copying logic for Image, including cloning PictureFormat if present.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Converts the Image object into DDL format using a Serializer.

methods.name: GetFilePath
methods.description: Returns the full file path of the image, considering base64 encoding, working directory, and document image path.
